question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and military following intensified purges of senior generals in January 2026, including close allies on the Central Military Commission, which eliminated potential rivals ahead of the 2027 party congress. These actions, combined with his third-term consolidation since 2022 and ongoing diplomatic engagements such as summits with U.S. leadership, reinforce trader consensus that abrupt removal through resignation, health failure, or internal challenge remains improbable before 2027. The opaque but centralized leadership structure prioritizes loyalty, with no verified reports of succession moves or instability in the intervening months. Rare shifts could still arise from sudden medical events, major policy reversals triggering elite fractures, or unforeseen external shocks, though current evidence shows limited pathways for such outcomes in the short resolution window.
